valueCreationScenarios.title: Midscale Longer-Stay New Build
valueCreationScenarios.summary: StudioRes fits owners building efficient midscale longer-stay studios when prototype economics and simplified operations match demand—without Residence Inn upscale residential intensity or Apartments soft-brand complexity.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Secondary Market Extended-Stay Coverage
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Secondary and suburban longer-stay nodes create StudioRes value when kitchenette studios meet affordable multi-night demand. Owners should separate TownePlace select-service and Element wellness lanes during diligence.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Conversion Path Where Officially Available
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Where Marriott positions StudioRes for conversion in applicable regions, owners must verify current official availability rather than inventing conversion scope. Do not borrow Residence Inn PIP assumptions.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Bonvoy Access For Affordable Longer Stays
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Affiliation helps when Bonvoy distribution matters for midscale longer stays. Value fades if sponsors present StudioRes as Residence Inn or Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy to capital partners.

scenarios.title: Midscale Longer-Stay Studio Positioning
scenarios.summary: StudioRes creates owner value when sponsors need an affordable midscale longer-stay studio product with efficient operations—not Residence Inn upscale suites, TownePlace select-service extended stay, Element wellness, or Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy. Underwrite only what official development materials support. No CALA examples are confirmed—keep International Reference labeling.

scenarios.title: US Canada New-Build Longer-Stay Economics
scenarios.summary: Owner value concentrates on US and Canada new-build longer-stay prototypes where studio product and staffing models stay efficient. Diligence site size, suite mix, and competitive midscale supply before modeling affiliation lift. Named references such as StudioRes Fort Myers require steward-confirmed property overview URLs before openings cards harden.

scenarios.title: Sibling Clarity Across Longer Stays
scenarios.summary: Marriott’s Longer Stays family lists StudioRes beside Residence Inn, TownePlace, and Element—use that map for distinction, never for interchangeable proof. Sequence systems and training for StudioRes midscale longer-stay realities only. Keep StudioRes product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the midscale longer-stay StudioRes by Marriott brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.
